To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a new method to investigate the structural integrity of cardiac muscle tissue in a fast, nondestructive, and noninvasive way.

a scanning X-ray diffractions experiment on cardiac tissue has been successfully performed, that a surprising amount and quality of structural data can easily be harvested from the data, that a data analysis pipeline has been established, and that the data analysis toolbox can be used for further studies on diseased tissue.

the structural properties of cardiac tissue can be studied by a scanning X-ray diffractions technique, and that the analysis of the data provides information about the local structure of the sarcomeres.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structural analysis of cardiac tissue by means of X-ray diffraction.
the development of a novel approach to characterize cardiac tissue by scanning X-ray diffractions.
the development and application of a scanning X-ray diffractions method to investigate the structural integrity of cardiac tissue.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study is an example of the potential of scanning X-ray diffractions in combination with modern detector technology.
the present study is a proof of concept for a novel method to study the structure of cardiac muscle tissue.
scanning X-ray diffractions is an ideal tool to characterize the structure of cardiac tissue.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presented method can provide a fast and reliable way for a quantitative characterization of tissue structure.
a scanning X-ray diffractions experiment on a cardiac tissue slice can reveal a wealth of structural information on a tissue level.
a scanning X-ray diffractions study can be performed in a few hours, including the data acquisition, the analysis, and the visualization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
scanning X-ray diffractions of cardiac tissue is feasible and can be performed with a high degree of automation.
the analysis of X-ray diffraction data can be automatized, and that the analysis can be performed in a fully quantitative fashion.
the analysis of the local structural information is a powerful method to study the structural integrity of tissue.
